admissionInfo.text: Admission to the BS program includes the following requirements: Completion of all general education courses. Completion of all lower division CJ courses with a C grade or higher. Completion of MATH 1080 (or MATH 1050 and MATH 1060), BIOL 1610, BIOL 1615, CHEM 1210, CHEM 1215, CHEM 1220, 1225, PHYS 2010, PHYS 2015 with a C grade or higher. Overall GPA of 2.7 or higher. Application for admission to BS Forensic Science program. Two academic letters of recommendation.
